messages:
amy-ops: Heads up — PMT-342 remediation is still showing as OPEN in the tracker. Was due last Thursday. Anyone owning closure?

remediation-bot: Reminder: Action PMT-342 overdue by 3 days. Owner: unassigned. Link: https://tracker/redwood/PMT-342

raj-platform: I picked this up but got blocked by integration tests failing. Working on a patch, ETA EOD today.

nora-sre: Raj — which tests? Can you paste failing step? We can pair to unblock.

raj-platform: Failing in `ci/integration/retries_test.go`, flake on `TestKVSExpiry`. Repro locally, pushing a WIP branch: https://git/repo/branches/fix/pmt-342

miguel-eng: If it needs infra, I can provision a debug cluster for you. But we need to mark ownership in the postmortem so it doesn't drift.

kevin-pm: This came up in the last 3 incidents — trend of retry edge case. Can we get a short plan + timeline so we can update stakeholders? cc @amy-ops

raj-platform: Plan: fix retry flakiness, add deterministic test harness, deploy canary to staging, then promote. Timeline: PR by today, canary tomorrow AM, production patch tomorrow EOD. I'll update tracker.

amy-ops: Please add yourself as owner in the tracker now. Add acceptance criteria: passing CI + 5k qps smoke test.

raj-platform: Done — updated tracker: owner=raj-platform, due=2026-03-20, acceptance=CI green + smoke. PR: #468

remediation-bot: Action PMT-342 assigned to raj-platform, due 2026-03-20.

nora-sre: I'll take canary monitoring, set alert for error spike >0.5%

kevin-pm: Good — after closure, please add a one-paragraph causal summary and a follow-on item to evaluate batching behavior across retries.

amy-ops: FYI I'm going to escalate to Eng Leads if not closed by EOD tomorrow.

raj-platform: Understood. Will push PR in 45m.

kevin-pm: Thanks. Also suggest scheduling a 30m retro with SRE + Platform to talk recurring pattern.

amy-ops: Agree. Putting tentative invite for Fri 3pm.

remediation-bot: Scheduled follow-up ping: 2026-03-21T15:00:00Z

miguel-eng: Thanks everyone. I'll review the PR once it's up.

amy-ops: Closing loop — if anyone hits a blocker ping me directly. :thumbsup:
